caption: The drawing features a rectangular grid occupying the majority of the page, drawn in fine, light grey lines. In the upper section of the grid, there are several segments of patterns and designs. These patterns include a zigzag line in green, a leafy motif in green, and a red vine with leaves or berries. The patterns are filled with solid green and red hues, while the background is beige with a fabric-like texture. The lower and central portions of the grid contain faint pencil sketches, forming outlines of leaves, flowers, and other botanical elements, though no color is applied to these parts. The drawing as a whole is placed on an off-white or slightly yellowed sheet, and the name "Paul Childers" is written in cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Technique Demo (Jacquard Coverlet)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
